webhooks.detail: Threads webhooks: Moderate topic (replies, delete) and Interaction topic (mentions, publish)

evidence.quote: Webhooks for Threads allow you to receive real-time notifications for the subscribed topics and fields.

sandbox.detail: No separate sandbox. Free Meta developer app; add Threads Testers via App roles to test without App Review.

evidence.quote: Threads testers can grant your app these permissions at any time.

rate_limits.summary: Calls per 24h = 4800 x impressions (min 10); 250 posts, 1,000 replies, 100 deletions per rolling 24h

evidence.quote: Threads profiles are limited to 250 API-published posts within a rolling 24-hour period.
